faqs.a:
Section 101.3. Intent,
is hereby amended by adding a new second paragraph to read as follows:
"
101.3. Intent.
Additions or alterations shall not be made to an existing building or structure when
                  such existing building or structure is not in full compliance with the provisions
                  of this code except when such addition or alteration will result in the existing building
                  or structure being no more hazardous based on life safety, fire safety, and sanitation,
                  than before such additions or alterations are undertaken."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 8, 9-14-2020)
